headline: Fresh Strongpoint Flips at Godcrofts, Lykos and Fingers
war_summary: Since the last edition the morning wire has grown busier. Godcrofts continues to exchange strongpoints at Argosa and Lipsia, with a fresh change logged at 10:25; Lykos Isle has followed suit around Fort Guile and The Squall, its latest flare at 10:10. Newest of all is The Fingers, where Headsman's Villa has seen three ownership events in the past two hours. Tempest Island has also stirred, with Blackwatch and Surge Gate entering the morning log. The DeadLands and Farranac Coast, lately so active, have gone quiet, as has Fishermans Row, which has not moved since late yesterday despite its big twenty-four-hour count. Casualty totals continue to climb at Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Clahstra and Marban Hollow without any strategic base changing hands. The war enters its ninety-second day, and neither side has yet reached the required thirty-four victory towns.
